notes: Raw printed text only. Mapping to effects happens later (PLAN T2.1/T2.2).
number is the printed card number (n/10). The extracted file order is not the printed order: cards are listed by printed number.
orientation: 'inverted' = printed upside down on the card (secrets, R-15.82, and some assets).

variants: a section without reputation subsections has a single variant with condition null. 'flavor' is the italic text; 'text' is the rules text. Several printed paragraphs are one string separated by '\n'.
A variant may carry its own 'secret' and 'orientation' when the secret box sits under a reputation condition.
Die icons: solid starburst = {HIT}, outlined spiky starburst = {CRIT}, eye = {FOCUS}.
Embedded assets keep the printed trait in 'traits' (ILLEGAL -> illegal).
Errata: 'errata' sits on the section it refers to; the printed text is kept as is (R-24.5: the printed second sentence is the opposite of the corrected rule).
STARTER SHIP is printed in bold small caps and kept in capitals.

variants.flavor: The citizens of Ryloth are desperate for supplies.
variants.text: You may deliver 1 of your cargo for its reward regardless of its destination. If it is ILLEGAL and you have {REP_POS} Rebel reputation, you can deliver it without rolling a die.

variants.flavor: A Naboo farmer has asked you to pick up some rare supplies.
variants.text: Action: If on Takodana, gain the cargo above.

variants.flavor: Cham Syndulla needs your help retaliating against the Empire.
variants.text: When you win a combat against an Imperial patrol, you may discard this card to gain 1 fame and 1 Rebel reputation.

variants.flavor: Life on the Emperor’s homeworld is good for loyal Imperial citizens.
variants.text: If you are not the most famous player, you may spend {CREDITS}7,000 to gain 1 fame. Otherwise, you may spend {CREDITS}15,000 to gain 1 fame.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Imperial reputation:
variants.flavor: You stumble upon a suspicious late-night gathering in an alley near Theed palace.
variants.text: Test Knowledge. If you pass, either gain 1 Rebel reputation or gain 1 Imperial reputation.

variants.flavor: A local Rebel cell is running dangerously low on supplies.
variants.text: You may discard 1 of your cargo, gear, or mods to gain {CREDITS}4,000 and 1 Rebel reputation. If you already had {REP_POS} Rebel reputation, instead of gaining credits gain 1 fame and lose 1 Imperial reputation.

variants.flavor: A farmer needs help disarming an unexploded booma from a bygone battle on her farm.
variants.text: You may test Tactics. If you pass, gain 1 Imperial reputation. If you already had {REP_POS} Imperial reputation, gain 1 fame instead. If you fail, your character suffers 3 damage.

variants.flavor: The Imperials have impounded a smuggler’s ship. You could probably steal it.
variants.text: You may lose 1 Imperial reputation to test Tech. If you pass, lose 1 fame to buy the top card of the {DECK_SHIP} market deck for free.

variants.flavor: You hear information regarding the whereabouts of some stolen Imperial equipment.
variants.text: Action: If on Nal Hutta, gain the cargo above and lose 1 Rebel reputation.

asset.name: Weapon Cache
text: To deliver, roll a die. On a {HIT}, deliver this. Otherwise, resolve card #1.

variants.flavor: It’s market day in the city of Lessu. That makes it the perfect time to buy and sell wares.
variants.text: You may discard 1 of your cargo to gain {CREDITS}3,000. If you do not discard a card, reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_GEAR}, {DECK_CARGO}, or {DECK_SHIP} market deck. You may buy 1 of these cards with a discount of {CREDITS}1,000. Then shuffle the deck.

variants.flavor: The governor asks you to negotiate with a visiting Hutt trade delegation, who promptly tries to bribe you.
variants.text: You may lose 1 Hutt reputation to gain 1 Imperial reputation or you may lose 1 Imperial reputation to gain {CREDITS}4,000 and 1 Hutt reputation.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_POS} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation:
variants.flavor: A Rebel sympathizer offers to let you purchase a ship from her personal collection.
variants.text: You may buy any ship sheet from the supply for its cost. Place the sheet on its “Ship Goal” side as normal. Then remove the ship’s card from the {DECK_SHIP} market deck and reshuffle the deck.

variants.flavor: You are caught in the middle of a firefight between Free Ryloth forces and a legion of stormtroopers.
variants.text: Your character suffers 3 damage. If you are not defeated, gain 1 Rebel reputation.

variants.flavor: A Rebel operative is seeding unrest. You consider turning her in to the Empire.
variants.text: You may lose 1 Rebel reputation to gain {CREDITS}2,000 and 1 Imperial reputation. You can do this even if you have {REP_NEG} Rebel reputation.

variants.flavor: A Rebel cell is looking to steal some gear from the local Imperial garrison.
variants.text: You may test Stealth. If you pass, buy 1 gear of your choice for free from the {DECK_GEAR} market deck. Then shuffle the deck. If you fail, lose 1 Imperial reputation and your character suffers 2 damage.

variants.condition: If you have {REP_NEG} or {REP_NEU} Rebel reputation:
variants.flavor: The Imperial occupation is making it difficult for Ryloth’s inhabitants to get supplies.
variants.text: You may discard 1 of your cargo to gain credits equal to its cost and 1 Rebel reputation.

variants.flavor: A Theed merchant is selling discount wares that you could sell off-world for a large markup.
variants.text: Reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_CARGO} market deck. You may buy 1 these cards with a discount of {CREDITS}1,000. Then shuffle the deck.

variants.flavor: A swarm of TIE interceptors appears on your scopes.
variants.text: You may fight a ship combat against TIE interceptors ({SHIP_COMBAT} 5). If you win, lose 1 Imperial reputation and gain 1 fame and 1 Rebel reputation.

variants.flavor: A nervous Gungan wants you to bring an important dignitary back to Otoh Gunga.
variants.text: Action: If on Mon Calamari, gain the cargo above.

variants.flavor: A Free Ryloth agent seeks vengeance.
variants.text: Action: Discard this card to fight a combat against a player in your space who has {REP_POS} Imperial reputation or {REP_NEG} Rebel reputation. If you win, you gain 1 fame.

variants.flavor: Imperial forces are searching the planet for outlaws, and they are willing to pay for information.
variants.text: You may test Knowledge. If you pass, gain 1 Imperial reputation and {CREDITS}4,000. If you fail, lose 1 Imperial reputation; if you already had {REP_NEG} Imperial reputation, lose {CREDITS}4,000.

variants.flavor: Gobi Glie is looking to purchase a quality ship for a secret mission.
variants.text:
If your ship is not a STARTER SHIP, you may replace your ship sheet with a STARTER SHIP sheet to gain 1 fame, 1 Rebel reputation, and {CREDITS}5,000.
If you do replace your ship sheet, you may lose 1 Imperial reputation to gain {CREDITS}4,000.

variants.flavor: At a cantina, you talk to an off-duty Imperial officer.
variants.text: You may lose 1 Rebel reputation. Then, if you have {REP_NEG} Rebel reputation, gain 1 Imperial reputation. If you already had {REP_POS} Imperial reputation, reveal the top 3 cards of the {DECK_CARGO} market deck. You may buy 1 revealed cargo for free. Then shuffle the deck.
